meta.title: Komi Komi Productions | Bar & Bat Mitzvah, Birthday Parties, Full Moon and Candy Bars
meta.description: Events for kids and teens in Israel: themed birthday parties, bar and bat mitzvah productions, Full Moon glow parties, clowns and DJs, candy bars, food stands and Purim activity stations.
meta.ogAlt: Komi Komi Productions – events for kids and teens

hero.eyebrow: Events for kids and teens · Birthdays · Bar & bat mitzvah
hero.title: The party your kids are dreaming of
hero.text: Themed birthdays, bar and bat mitzvahs, Full Moon parties and Purim. We arrive with everything: decor, DJ, entertainers and a candy bar.

home.catalogTitle: Build your event, one attraction at a time
home.catalogText: Pick what interests you and add it to your quote. Send us everything in a single message at the end.
home.themesTitle: Which world do they love right now?

blocks.title: A party that arrives ready
blocks.text: You choose a date and a theme. We bring decor, sound, entertainers, sweets and prizes, set everything up and take it down afterwards.

blocks.title: Entertainers and DJs who know kids
blocks.text: Liraz, Kobi and the team know how to bring even the shy child onto the dance floor. Activities are adapted to each age, from 3 to bar and bat mitzvah.

blocks.title: A candy bar people photograph before eating
blocks.text: A kosher sweet table styled to your concept, plus hot, dairy and parve food stands that feed every guest.

home.worksText: Every photo on this site was taken at an event we produced.
home.localTitle: We come to you, from Nahariya to Ashkelon
home.ctaTitle: Tell us what you are celebrating
home.ctaText: Fill in a few details and we will come back with a clear quote.

reviews.title: Our clients recommend
